name: The Master Cut

start.dialog: I need the perfect cut. Bog-boar ribs. The big ones. From the alpha male in the Deep Muck. Dangerous? Sure. Worth it? Absolutely. You look like you can handle a boar.
start.objective: Hunt the alpha bog-boar in the Deep Muck and bring back its ribs

progress.dialog: Alpha bog-boar. Big tusks, scarred hide, attitude problem. His ribs are legendary. Bring them to me.
progress.objective: Continue searching the Deep Muck for the alpha bog-boar

complete.dialog: THOSE RIBS! Look at the marbling! The color! This will be my masterpiece! Here - eat free at the Skillet, anytime. And take this. My personal spice blend. Don't share it.

party_comments.kade: That boar was huge! Good eating though.
party_comments.twist: I'm hungry just smelling these ribs!
party_comments.nix7: Nutritional analysis: high protein. Culinary value: exceptional.

hidden_outcome: If you bring the ribs AND rare herbs from the Mire depths, Gus creates 'Ultimate BBQ' that permanently increases max HP by 50
